_comment: Section III-D cross-tool voting parameters. weight = per-engine reliability w_i (calibrated on a held-out set in the paper; these are the prototype defaults). detects = capability tags the engine authoritatively covers, used to build the applicable-engine set E: an engine counts toward E for a finding only if it RAN on the host and the finding's tag is in its detects. confirms = tags for which this engine is an active confirmation adapter, i.e. v(f)=1 when such an engine is among the detectors. tau = admission threshold, gamma = confirmation bonus. tau/gamma may be overridden per run with WAPTRIX_VOTE_TAU / WAPTRIX_VOTE_GAMMA.
